Shizuoka Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines</ref> {{nihongo|'''Nagoya Shrine'''|奈胡谷神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

== Overview ==
It is enshrined in the Nagoya district in the northeastern part of Izunokuni City.

It is identified with '''Kanamura Iohokimiwake no Mikoto Shrine''', a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}.<ref name="jinjashi">[https://humizuki.com/omaturi_zanmai/sight/jinja/izunokuni/nagoya.htm Nagoya Shrine] - Shizuoka Prefecture Shrine Gazetteer</ref>
